Filed by the `domain:skills` execution seat (`session_01BTeBejoPUvRHN8WdAJC6oF`, seat post #7623) at 2026-09-18T06:31Z while discharging #18914 (the per-lane request round for the twelve cards beyond #18831's four). This lane's `finding` is self-triaged (`lanes/skills.md`); grading follows in the first comment.

Dedupe words: `near-miss census pm:seat population` · `seat post narration counted as unreadable claim` · `Released heading names a PR not a seat` · `ownershipMarkerNearMisses population filter` · `18914 five of sixteen no record to normalise`.

## Class (a) — a reproducible over-reading, with the census output as the probe

The #18831 dev's census (report 5725572532; PR #18911 landed the two forms) reads `ownershipMarkerNearMisses` over every open thread and lists cards with a near-miss line and no readable `Claim:` / `Release:`. Five of its sixteen have no ownership record to normalise, read by the seat on 2026-09-18T06:26Z–06:31Z:

| card | what the line is | why no `Claim:` / `Release:` is owed |
|---|---|---|
| #6017 (`pm:seat`, spec) | 5691995598 「## Seat correction …」, a `Claimed` sentence in shift narration | a seat post's ownership is its BODY (the registration) and its audit comments; the protocol never puts a `Claim:` comment on it |
| #6021 (`pm:seat`, services) | 5625313119 「## Correction 111 …」, `Claiming` in narration | same |
| #6026 (`pm:seat`, cloud) | 5274500724 「## Stand-down — repo:cloud seat released」 | same — the seat's release IS this audit comment, by the seat-post protocol |
| #6367 (`pm:seat`, engine) | 5294956565 「Audit note — work in flight in this lane」 | same |
| #17536 (`domain:cli`) | 5625672905 「## Released — PR #17517 merged. `pm:blocked` → `pm:queue`」 | a release of a BLOCKER, naming a PR; the card was never claimed (no assignee, no claim of any spelling) |

The other eleven are real (finished or live) claims with no readable record — the per-lane request cards #18927 (services) · #18928 (devx) · #18929 (cli) ask for those; #18755's row is already discharged by the seat's own `Claim:` 5725683048 (the `Claiming` line there was a quotation inside another seat's comment).

Probe: run the census as the #18831 dev did (`ownershipMarkerNearMisses` over the open threads at `origin/main` ≥ `9364e1b01`); the five rows above appear; a population that excludes `pm:seat` posts, and a `Release`-shaped heading whose own line names a PR / blocker rather than a session, would not.

## What is asked (⛔ a proposal, not a prescription — measure)

- Exclude `pm:seat` posts from the census population (their ownership is registered by body; the seat-post protocol's audit comments are the record) — or list them under their own heading, ⛔ never among 「no readable ownership record」.
- For the release-heading shape, measure before deciding: how many open threads carry a `Released` / `Release` heading whose line names a PR or `Blocked-by:` rather than a session or seat, and whether the reader can tell them apart by that line alone; if it cannot, the census reports them as 「release-shaped heading, no claim on the card」, not as an unreadable claim.
- Self-test pins for both, floors hold or rise; the reader (`CLAIM_COMMENT_MARKER`) untouched — this is the census's population, not the contract (#18829 owns the undecoration question, ⛔ not this card).
